answer: Retroactive fraud windows keep every seat's earnings at risk long after the work is done. Rewards, say for grading ferrous scrap price forecasts, sit in a per-seat time-locked vault for 30 days, or 120 epochs. Within that window anyone may post a duplication proof, such as two seats leaking the same private signal, and claim half the locked balance while the rest burns. A seat earning 20 POA per epoch always has 2,400 POA exposed, so a 50-seat farm risks 120,000 POA. Rotating to fresh seats does not help, since each new seat starts its own 30-day lock.
